-- تحليل الجامعات المغذة للشركات الكبرى (أعلى 50 شركة)
WITH TopCompanies AS (
    SELECT employer_id, employer_name
    FROM estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala
    WHERE is_active_job = 1
    AND employer_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY employer_id, employer_name
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 50
),
UniversityCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        TRIM(u.university_name) AS university_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS graduate_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala u
    INNER JOIN estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala j ON u.id = j.id
    INNER JOIN TopCompanies tc ON j.employer_id = tc.employer_id
    WHERE j.is_active_job = 1
    AND u.graduation_date IS NOT NULL
    AND u.qualification IN ('بكالوريوس', 'ماجستير', 'دكتوراه', 'زمالة')
    GROUP BY TRIM(u.university_name)
)
SELECT 
    university_name,
    graduate_count
FROM UniversityCounts
WHERE graduate_count > 0
ORDER BY graduate_count DESC
LIMIT 30
